subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these travel-expense records.

judge.implied_focus: The nature and provenance of procured assets underlying the travel-expense records (asset acquisition/lifecycle profiling)

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: Classifies what kind of asset the expense represents -- a core facet of an asset-centric focus.

per_column.name: creation_mode
per_column.rationale: Describes how the record/asset entry was generated (automated vs manual), a provenance facet of asset acquisition.

per_column.name: business_purpose
per_column.rationale: Ties each asset to why it was acquired; coheres with an acquisition-purpose framing.

per_column.name: asset_specificity
per_column.rationale: Granularity of asset identification (named model vs generic vs service) -- an attribute of the asset concept.

per_column.name: department_span
per_column.rationale: Essentially restates the existing department column; a spend/owner dimension, only loosely about the asset focus.

per_column.name: processing_lag_signal
per_column.rationale: Derived timing metric from processed vs opened dates; a data-quality/process facet, not an asset attribute.

per_column.name: source_tracking_completeness
per_column.rationale: Bare presence/absence flag on source_id -- a generic data-completeness check, not asset-focused.

per_column.name: asset_lifecycle_stage
per_column.rationale: Places the asset in acquisition/registration/maintenance stages -- a genuine lifecycle facet of the asset focus.

judge.rationale: A majority of columns (asset_category, asset_specificity, asset_lifecycle_stage, creation_mode, business_purpose) do centre on a coherent asset-acquisition/provenance concept, so an implied focus is inferable and the set is not a pure grab-bag. However, coherence is diluted by three off-theme additions: department_span merely restates an existing column, while processing_lag_signal and source_tracking_completeness are generic process/data-quality flags that pull toward a different (data-hygiene) axis. Structurally the asset facets form a reasonable multi-faceted decomposition (type, specificity, lifecycle, purpose, provenance), but the mixing of asset facets with completeness/timing signals weakens it as a clean predictor/attribute set. The focus is somewhat actionable -- an analyst could investigate what assets drive travel expenses and how they are procured -- but there is notable tension because the operator reframed 'travel-expense records' as an asset-procurement problem, which may not match the spend/cost focus the query most naturally invites, capping actionability.
